title: ED-IT
description:
The official game made for the Git Together 1 jam!

You are a robot named Ed with the ability to dream. Use your abilities to platform through levels and dream your way around obstacles.Features• Play through seven unique stages with an emphasis on different mechanics.

• Use "dream mode" to edit your surroundings and imagine solutions to these challenges.

• Hug giraffes.
ControlsMove - WASD / Arrow keys
Dream mode - Right mouse button
Place/delete blocks - Left/right mouse button while in dream mode
